prompt: You and a quieter classmate did a joint project together, but your teacher praises you alone in class as if it was mainly your work. What response is fairest to your partner?

options.text: Accept all the praise and enjoy it, since the teacher chose to give it to you
Whisper to your partner that you will mention them later, then let the moment pass
Thank the teacher and clearly name the specific parts your partner led or contributed in front of the class
Refuse all the credit and say you did nothing, so your partner gets everything

explanation: Naming your partner's real contributions in the moment corrects the record while it matters. False modesty erases your own work, and a private promise to mention them later rarely fixes a public misunderstanding.
